outcome: Proliferative T-cell responses to non-inherited maternal antigens (NIMA)
cohort: 38 term neonates born by caesarean section
finding: Exclusively breastfed neonates had a nearly twofold higher proportion of regulatory T cells (Tregs) at 3 weeks of age compared to formula-fed neonates, along with a Treg-dependent reduction in proliferative T-cell responses to non-inherited maternal antigens and reduced inflammatory cytokine production.
